correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=1 and each nonempty binary pattern, greedily minimizing over starting phases yields a run formula: a one-run pattern length qd+s spans q(a+b)+s; with >=2 runs it spans (a+b)sum q_i+s_1+s_r+sum internal block capacities. The unique maximal-run decomposition yields the displayed rational bivariate generating function H=F_a+F_b+(2F_aF_b+F_a^2G_b+F_b^2G_a)/(1-G_aG_b). A nonnegative slack and parity decomposition bounds the maximal span, including separate m=min(a,b)=1, m=2, and m>=3 regimes. Exact independent phase-by-phase greedy source scans match span and threshold for all 8,160 binary patterns for 1<=a,b<=4 and 1<=pattern length<=8; finite tests are only checks, while the run argument proves all parameters. The threshold concerns union over windows, not a single window containing all patterns.
